criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: Abstention mechanism is non-functional: abstain_rate=1.0, coverage=0.0 at all thresholds, selective_risk=1.0 — provides zero selective-prediction benefit over blanket human review
All 7,180 test samples routed to human review; no samples are selectively accepted or rejected with differential confidence

Architecture research suggests ±10° random rotation as secondary augmentation, but the representation plan uses only hflip/brightness/contrast; not a conflict but a traceability gap worth documenting
Cancer-associated stroma (class 7) recall is only 0.458 (F1 0.602); smooth muscle and debris also below 0.85 F1 – histologically similar classes drive most errors
Cancer-associated stroma recall 0.458 and smooth muscle recall 0.838 suggest the model's confidence is least reliable on the hardest classes, likely driving the inverted OOD signal

Deterministic warning: architecture coverage incomplete — residual_cnn and resnet18 were never evaluated despite being in the architecture_research priority list and the 8-trial budget being fully consumed by only 3 families
Model is more confident on Gaussian-noise-corrupted inputs than on clean in-distribution inputs, indicating a fundamental confidence-calibration defect under this corruption family
No OOD / corruption-severity AUROC evaluation present in the supplied evidence; if required by the pipeline, this component is missing
No OOD detector qualified on validation (best val AUROC 0.555 < 0.65 threshold); automatic acceptance correctly disabled
OOD AUROC 0.183 is below random chance (0.5); max_softmax confidence is anti-correlated with OOD-ness across all three corruption severities
Predictive entropy AUROC is also below chance (mean ≈ 0.140), confirming the issue is not score-specific but model-calibration-related

Prior-art traceability: augmentation_regularization, ghostnet_vgg_robustness, and temperature_scaling_calibration ideas infer beyond the quoted scope of their cited papers; treat as unconfirmed hypotheses
Risk-coverage curve is degenerate: (coverage=0, risk=1.0) at every target coverage level from 0.5 to 0.9
Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) is from a different clinical center; OOD AUROC aggregates must be interpreted as cross-center domain shift, not in-distribution performance
